data.title: Butenafine & naftifine
data.summary: Topical antifungals · Benzylamine (butenafine) and allylamine (naftifine) antifungals
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antifungals_

**Class:** Benzylamine (butenafine) and allylamine (naftifine) antifungals

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibit squalene epoxidase → fungicidal against dermatophytes; anti-inflammatory (naftifine)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea pedis, corporis, cruris; pityriasis versicolor (butenafine)

## Dose & formulations
- Butenafine 1% once daily for 2 weeks (corporis/cruris) or 4 weeks (pedis); naftifine 1–2% once daily for 2–4 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Burning, irritation, contact dermatitis (rare)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Acceptable.

## Viva points
- Same target as terbinafine (squalene epoxidase) — fungicidal

_Sources: Khopkar ch.19; Wolverton 4e ch.42. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
